neighbours.label: ' until' introducing an exhaustion limit on a first-come allocation (until space is full, until all places are filled, until none remain); quiet on temporal 'until'
fire: Registrations are processed in the order they arrive until the course is full.
Free samples will be given to visitors until stocks run out.
Volunteers are signed up as they come until every shift is covered.
Rooms are assigned to early callers until the hotel is fully booked.
Grants are awarded on a rolling basis until the fund is exhausted.
Parking passes are issued each morning until the lot is full.
Donated coats will be handed to families until no more are left.
Bids are accepted one by one until every lot has been sold.
quiet: Registrations are processed in the office until five o'clock.
Free samples were given to visitors until the mayor spoke.
Volunteers stayed at the shelter until the storm passed.
Rooms are cleaned each morning until noon.
Grants were frozen until the new director took office.
Parking is free each morning until nine.
Simmer the donated beans gently until they soften.
Bidding was paused until the auctioneer returned.

notes: Probes: 'until space is full' 0.68, 'until the hall is full' 0.79, 'until none remain' 0.72, 'until all places are filled' 0.71; 'until Friday', 'until he arrived', 'until it thickens' under 0.03.
